title: The Sword of Courage
moral: True courage comes from the heart.

scenes.summary: Lady Elara begins her quest to find the legendary sword.
scenes.text: Lady Elara, a brave knight, heard about a legendary sword hidden in a cave. She decided to find it to protect her village, along with her friend Finn.
scenes.image_prompt: female knight and fox starting adventure village background cartoon style
scenes.story: Lady Elara was a brave knight who wanted to protect her village. She heard about a legendary sword hidden in a cave guarded by a dragon. With her friend Finn, she went on a journey. In the cave, they found the sword but faced the dragon. Elara solved a riddle and completed a challenge by climbing to get a feather. The dragon allowed her to take the sword. She returned home as a hero, ready to protect her village.
